# Astropad

> Astropad creates innovative hardware and software for creative professionals, including wireless displays, screen protectors, and productivity apps for iPad and Mac.

Astropad specializes in tools designed for digital creators and professionals who work across Apple devices. Their product ecosystem includes Luna Display for wireless second displays, Rock Paper Pencil for paper-like iPad drawing, Fresh Coat protective glass, and Rock Daily Planner for productivity.

## Key Topics

- Luna Display
- Rock Paper Pencil
- Fresh Coat
- Rock Daily Planner
- Astropad Studio
- iPad
- Apple Pencil
- Screen protector
- Wireless display
- Task management
- Habit tracking
- Paper texture
- Anti-reflective coating
- Mac compatibility
- iPad App Store

## Products & Shop

- [Shop Astropad](https://shop.astropad.com/collections/shop-astropad): Astropad product shop showcasing Luna Display, Rock Paper Pencil, Fresh Coat, and other accessories for creative professionals
- [Luna Display](https://shop.astropad.com/collections/shop-astropad/products/luna-display): Luna Display wireless second display hardware for Mac and iPad to extend your workspace
- [Rock Paper Pencil](https://shop.astropad.com/products/rock-paper-pencil): Rock Paper Pencil iPad screen protector with paper texture and Apple Pencil tips for natural drawing and writing
- [Fresh Coat](https://shop.astropad.com/products/fresh-coat): Fresh Coat anti-reflective iPhone screen protector with optical-grade AR coating for enhanced clarity
- [Rock Daily Planner](https://shop.astropad.com/products/rock-daily-planner): Rock Daily Planner iPad app for daily task management, habit tracking, and productivity with handwritten note support
